title: Job Openings at Medmax Pharmacy Limited
content:
Medmax Pharmacy Limited is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) Cashier

Job Location: Amuwo / Ago, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Core Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Process payments via cash, credit/debit cards.
	Maintain an accurate cash drawer throughout the shift.
	Count and balance the register at the start and end of shifts.
	Report discrepancies, counterfeit bills or suspicious transactions to management.
	Prepare bank deposits when required.
	Verify customer identity and confirm prescription pickup details.


Salary
N60,000 - N80,000 / month.

Application Closing Date: 25th October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Registered Nurse

Job Location: Amuwo/Ago, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	You will serve as Pharmacy Assistant/Nurse and to support the pharmacist in dispensing medications, managing inventory, and providing excellent customer service.


Responsibilities


	Customer Service and Sales: Greet customers and answer basic questions, process over-the-counter (OTC) sales and handle cash/credit or POS transactions. Refer all medication-related questions to the pharmacist.
	Prescription Support: Receive written or electronic prescriptions from customers. Prepare labels, count pills and package medications for pharmacist verification.
	Inventory Management: Receive, unpack and stock pharmaceutical deliveries, check expiry dates and rotate stock (FIFO- first in, first out), monitor low-stock items and alert the pharmacist for reordering. Maintain cleanliness of shelves and storage areas.
	Administrative: Maintain patient confidentiality, schedule patient consultations, file prescription records.
	Pharmacy Maintenance: Maintain clean workstation, counter. Ensure proper disposal of expired or damaged medications. Follow all safety and sanitation protocols.


Salary
N80,000 - N100,000 / month.

Application Closing Date: 25th October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

3.) Intern Pharmacist

Job Location: Amuwo/Ago, Lagos
Employment Type: Internship

Core Internship Responsibilities
Your duties and responsibilities shall include:


	Dispensing Support: assist in the accurate dispensing of prescription and over-the-counter OTC medications under the supervision of the pharmacist; receive and process prescription orders, ensuring completeness and correctness. Label and package medications correctly, including appropriate dosage and auxiliary labels.
	Patient Care and Counseling: Provide counseling support on proper medication usage, dosage, and side effects under the guidance of a supervising pharmacist. Conduct basic health screenings (blood pressure, blood glucose or sugar) as directed. Respond to patient inquiries and refer complex clinical questions to the supervising pharmacist. Maintain patient confidentiality and accurate patient medication records.
	Inventory and Stock Management: Assist in receiving, inspecting, and shelving pharmaceutical supplies and consumables. Monitor stock levels, rotate inventory (FIFO - first in, first out), and identify near-expiry or damaged products. Participate in periodic stock counts and reconciliation exercises.
	Administrative and Operational Support: Maintain cleanliness and organization of the pharmacy premises, shelves, and workstations.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 / month. 

Application Closing Date: 23rd October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

4.) Pharmacist

Job Location: Amuo/Ago, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced pharmacist to join our team.
	The ideal candidate must have a strong clinical background, excellent attention to details and a commitment to patient safety and care.


Responsibilties


	You will be responsible for dispensing medications.
	Advising patients and ensuring compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements.


Requirements
Clinical Knowledge:


	Deep understanding of pharmacology.
	Drug interactions, dosages etc
	Ability to verify prescription with zero error rate.
	Skilled in explaining medication usuage, side effects empathetically.


Inventoiry Management:


	Experienced in managing stock levels, expiry dates and cold chain products.
	Time management.
	Willingness to stay updated.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly

Application Closing Date: 26th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, cover letter and license details to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Data Entry Operator (HMIS Officer) Job at INTERSOS Nigeria




        
    

        
        INTERSOS is an independent humanitarian organization that assists the victims of natural disasters, armed conflicts and exclusion. Its activities are based on the principles of solidarity, justice, human dignity, equality of rights and opportunities, respect for diversity and coexistence, paying special attention to the most vulnerable people.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Data Entry Operator (HMIS Officer)

Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno

Job Purpose
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The incumbent will be responsible for collecting field immunization data, verifying its accuracy, compiling monthly reports, and submitting them to the EPI Department and the INTERSOS Health and MEAL teams in Maiduguri.
	The incumbent will also receive EPI registers, tally sheets, and other reporting tools from the EPI Department in Maiduguri and distribute them to health facilities.
	This will ensure that field teams consistently use standardized SMOH templates throughout the implementation of the Gates Foundation project.


Responsibilities


	Responsible for receiving EPI registers, tally sheets, and other routine immunization data collection tools from the State Ministry of Health (SMOH) EPI Department and distributing them to health facilities and mobile clinics as needed.
	Responsible for training field vaccinators, outreach teams, and community health workers/volunteers on the correct use of EPI tools and reporting formats.
	Supports field vaccinators and medical activity managers to develop micro-plans based on catchment population data.
	Compiles monthly routine immunization and nOPV2 vaccination coverage data, and produces reports for the health team detailing the number of children vaccinated, defaulters and polio-related AEFI cases etc.
	Supports the health and MEAL teams to extract data from the immunization database and generate reports aligned with Gates Foundation and SMOH (EPI) reporting requirements and guidelines.
	conducts regular field visits to ensure that data collection and reporting at facility and outreach levels meet SMOH, INTERSOS, and GF standards and guidance.
	Coordinates with the pharmacy team to collect vaccine stock and utilization data, including vaccine types and doses (including nOPV2), total quantities used, and quantities damaged and/or expired.
	Participates in monthly SMOH (EPI Department) meetings in consultation with the Medical Coordinator and the Technical Manager.


Education & Professional Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma in Public Health, Health information management, Statistics, Nursing or equivalent.


Professional requirements:


	At least 6 months of previous work experience in a data-management role in NGO
	Able to learn and use software used for recording
	Essential computer literacy (word, excel)


Personal requirements:


	Results and quality orientation
	Teamwork and cooperation
	Behavioural flexibility
	Service orientation
	Commitment to INTERSOS principle


Languages:


	Proficiency in English (written and spoken)
	Knowledge and fluency in English and local languages (Hausa and Kanuri) will be an asset.

title: Job Openings at Greenland Hall
content:
Greenland Hall is an excellent school, providing high-quality education both in the classroom and through a wide range of co-curricular activities. We have a history of high performance and put much of our success down to being an inclusive school at the heart of the community we serve.

We have high aspirations for all our students, and our goal is to improve the life chances of every learner, irrespective of their starting point. We believe that achievement leads to opportunity and choice, and this underpins all of our work in school.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) School Bus Driver

Job Locations: Lagos & Ogun
Job Type: Full-time
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Summary


	We are hiring a reliable School Bus Driver to transport students safely to and from school and activities.


Key Responsibilities


	Safely drive designated routes and adhere to schedules.
	Perform daily pre-trip and post-trip vehicle safety checks.
	Maintain order, safety, and discipline on the bus.
	Follow all traffic laws and transport safety regulations.


Requirements


	Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Can assist to financially facilitate one)
	Prior professional driving experience (school bus experience preferred).
	Strong communication skills and patience with children.
	Must pass background check and medical fitness screening.


Salary
N50,000 - N100,000/month.

Application Closing Date: 13th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Preschool Teacher

Job Locations: Lagos & Ogun
Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a compassionate, enthusiastic, and dedicated Preschool Teacher to join our early childhood education team.
	In this role, you will create a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment where children aged 3 to 5 can explore, learn, and grow emotionally, socially, and academically.
	If you are passionate about early childhood development and love helping young minds discover the world around them, we would love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities


	Curriculum & Instruction: Plan and implement age-appropriate, play-based lesson plans that cover early literacy, basic math concepts, arts and crafts, music, and motor skills.
	Classroom Management: Establish clear, gentle guidelines for behavior to foster a safe, respectful, and inclusive classroom environment.
	Child Development & Assessment: Observe and track each child’s developmental milestones, social interactions, and learning progress.
	Safety & Care: Maintain high standards of hygiene, health, and safety, ensuring all safety and regulatory guidelines are strictly followed.
	Communication & Collaboration: Partner with parents and guardians through regular updates, parent-teacher conferences, and daily check-ins regarding their child’s progress and well-being.
	Social-Emotional Learning: Guide children in developing self-regulation, empathy, sharing, and problem-solving skills through cooperative play and group activities.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education, Child Development, or a related field (or CDA Credential).
	Experience: Minimum of [1–2 years] of experience working with preschool-aged children in a licensed daycare or classroom setting.


Certifications:


	CPR and First Aid Certification (or willingness to obtain within 30 days of hire).
	Child Care Background Clearance.


Skills:


	Exceptional patience, creativity, and energy.
	Strong oral and written communication skills.
	Ability to adapt activities to support diverse learning styles and developmental stages.
	Capability to lift up to 30 lbs and participate in active play (bending, kneeling, sitting on the floor).


Benefits


	Competitive Salary N50,000 - n100,000/month
	Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
	Childcare discounts for employees
	Ongoing professional development and training opportunities


Application Closing Date: 30th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Mathematics Teacher 

Job Locations: Lagos & Ogun
Job Type: Full-time

Position Overview


	We are seeking an enthusiastic and skilled Mathematics Teacher to foster mathematical literacy, logical reasoning, and critical problem-solving skills.
	The ideal candidate will inspire confidence in students across various math levels—ranging from foundational algebra and geometry to advanced calculus and statistics—making complex concepts clear and approachable.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan and deliver engaging, structured lessons in core mathematical disciplines (Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Calculus, and Statistics).
	Teach step-by-step problem-solving techniques and encourage logical, analytical thinking.
	Assess student performance through homework, problem sets, diagnostic tests, and cumulative examinations.
	Differentiate math instruction to support students who require extra help while challenging advanced learners.
	Integrate educational technology, such as dynamic graphing tools and interactive displays, into daily lessons.
	Maintain an orderly, encouraging classroom environment where students feel comfortable taking academic risks.
	Track academic progress and communicate regularly with parents, department heads, and school counselors.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Mathematics Education, or a closely related quantitative field (Master’s Degree preferred).
	Licensure: Valid state or national teaching credential for secondary mathematics.
	Experience: 2+ years of experience teaching middle school or high school mathematics preferred.
	Technical Skills: Proficiency with graphing calculators, mathematical visualization software (e.g., Desmos, GeoGebra), and learning management systems.
	Soft Skills: High patience, exceptional step-by-step explanatory skills, strong classroom management, and an encouraging demeanor.


Salary
N100,000 – N150,000 Monthly.

Application Closing Date: 30th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "title": "Major Projects Manager",
  "description": "Bell OIl and Gas Limited is a leading indigenous oilfield services company, dedicated to consistently proffering solutions, driving local content development and capacity building in Nigeria.

We offer an extensive range of high quality professional services to clients across the facets of oil and gas industry and other industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Major Projects Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Overall Purpose of Job


	Management of all company projects; supervising the packaging and submission of all company bidpackages, the collation of all project data, the planning and analysis of all projects, monitoring, evaluation,and execution of all projects, and also the management of all project office staff.


Responsibilities


	Oversees the preparation of bids/proposals.
	Reviews ALL tender documents and supervises the compilation of materials required for bids.
	Oversees all NIPEX registrations.
	Ensures smooth liaison with NIPEX.
